answers.q1_end_to_end: Pinned hops 1-11 above: main.lua:695 -> LuaMod(notify-cancel):4700 binding -> 4762 queue (m_engine_tick_actions, host-side vector) -> pump = EngineTick detour armed by final-units:1913 (AddCallback->EnsureHooked->PLH::x64Detour on UEngine::TickInternal, address assigned at final-units:1893 from the live vtable) -> engine's real GameEngine::Tick fires the detour -> LuaMod(notify-cancel):4467 engine_tick_hook (IsInGameThreadRaw-gated by the initializer's publication, final-units:172) -> 4488 process_simple_actions -> 4137-4138 lua call -> LuaMadeSimple.cpp:971 lua_pcall. The engine function the drain ultimately needs is the game's own GameEngine::Tick executing through the detour — nothing else.
answers.q2_drain_requires: ONLY the EngineTick closure. ProcessEvent / CallFunction / any UFunction machinery appear NOWHERE in the enqueue->drain path (the drain is lua_pcall on the hook Lua state). ProcessEvent is needed only by the OTHER method branch (ExecuteInGameThread(closure, EGameThreadMethod.ProcessEvent), launch-10 never takes it — settings pin EngineTick) and by the mod's own ':' UFunction calls ABOVE the drain (menu UI + the actual BeginDeferredActorSpawnFromClass spawn).
answers.q3_resolve_method: EngineTickResolveMethod default = Scan (SettingsManager.hpp:126; staged console ini has no [Hooks] section so the default stands; HookEngineTick default true, SettingsManager.hpp:125, unchanged). Armed build: scan arm is structurally dead (final-units:1867-1878 comment; scan_address null), so Initialize takes the Scan branch's VTABLE FALLBACK at 1892-1893. The resolve DOES need exec-page-readable content: (a) every OPTIONAL_GET_ADDRESS_OF_UNREAL_VIRTUAL performs a Zydis data-read of the target's first instruction bytes (UnrealVirtualBaseVC.hpp:133 -> ASMHelper.cpp:52->9-22) — LoadMap at 1819 is the FIRST such walk, before tick; (b) PLH::x64Detour::hook() disassembles up to 100 bytes at the target (x64Detour.cpp:325). FLAG AS REQUESTED: the tick registration path performs data-mode reads of exec pages, unmitigated in launch10-final-a (walkguard candidate not composed). Whether those reads fault is the NOT-localized igf6 mechanism (exec-only enforcement is the leading hypothesis, never reached in-game: igf6 was interrupted before the first exec-span read; launch-9 refused upstream of the initializer at the PLH lease read + facts adapter). The detour WRITE is separately governed (FLAG-1) and fails LOUD (named throw final-units:1916) if refused.
answers.q4_address: CONFIRMED at tier-1 (capstone byte decode, no Ghidra run): valid x86-64 function prologue at linked vaddr 0x2fac8c0 in the sha-pinned retained eboot; runtime 0x33ac8c0 = base 0x400000 + 0x2fac8c0 matches the CP2 pin, the SeedTable translation rule, and oracle row F29's expected log value. What launch-10 runtime evidence still resolves: whether the LIVE vtable entry actually holds 0x33ac8c0 (the F29 log line prints it) and whether reads/writes on that page survive (F29 walk survival + no registration-failure throw).
answers.q5_verdict: CONDITIONAL — see DRAIN-TRACE.md. The drain mechanism is source-complete and needs only the EngineTick closure (mod-load-readiness is RIGHT at the Lua level). But the pump arm sits on two unproven in-game exec-page verdicts exactly as pc-ps5-comparison warned (exec READ at the resolve+disassembly hops, exec WRITE at the detour patch), and the menu/spawn EXECUTION above the drain additionally sits on the UFunction-call machinery (ProcessEvent) that is the known adapter gap (DIFF-1 funcptr-marshal fix not composable into launch-10). Matrix rows already encode this: R1/R2 need W_WORKS; R5 (BOTH_FAIL) explicitly states 'F7-2 dead (no closure drain)' — the same conclusion this trace derives from source.

deciding_runtime_evidence: F29 walk survival (UE4SS.log): 'Finding GameEngine::LoadMap' -> 'GameEngine::LoadMap address 0x<hex>' -> 'Finding GameEngine::Tick' -> 'GameEngine::Tick address (vtable: 0x33ac8c0; scan: 0x0)' -> 'Scan failed, falling back to vtable address for GameEngine::Tick' (final-units:1827,1831,1892) and progression to 'Finding GameModeBase::InitGameState' (1936). Log ending mid-lines after 'Finding GameEngine::LoadMap' = exec-read fault class = SPAWN-PATH-BLOCKED at the resolve walks.

Absence of the named throw in status failed detail: 'Native game-thread initializer callback registration failed' (final-units:1916) or 'Query harness tick dispatch callback registration failed' (1926). Presence = detour write refused (FLAG-1) = loud BLOCKED at the pump arm.
status 'state <k> engine-ready 0' (RuntimeAckSink::engine_ready, runtime_owner.cpp:172) — initializer completed; the pump registrations survived.

FIRST-DRAIN PROOF (the log lines the task asks for): after F7, UE4SS.log shows '[Lua] [TownfallItemSpawner] Menu created.' (main.lua:643, executed INSIDE the drained toggleMenu->buildUI closure). '[Lua] [TownfallItemSpawner] UI creation failed: <err>' (main.lua:636) equally proves the drain ran (the closure executed and failed above it). F7 pressed with NEITHER line and no Lua error line = the drain never ran (publication or pump failure — silent class, hop 10). Precondition line at mod load: '[Lua] [TownfallItemSpawner] Loaded v1.0. Clean pickup-only release. F7 opens the menu.' (main.lua:746) proves mod load, NOT the drain (it runs at script load).

Menu-open beyond the drain still needs the UFunction calls to work (main.lua:529/633/634 un-pcall'd); the visible spawn needs BeginDeferredActorSpawnFromClass/FinishSpawningActor (main.lua:297-301) — success line '[Lua] [TownfallItemSpawner] Spawned <item> x<n> ID=<id>' (main.lua:335 via 337 status). That is the adapter-machinery question OUTSIDE this trace's drain scope.
